demo.title: staq.txt
demo.code:
You: Enable STAQ, 10% of every trade
Agent: (echoes the rule in plain language, waits for your explicit yes, then signs it with your wallet)
You: (you trade normally, STAQ is silent)
You: How much have I STAQ'd?
Agent: You've saved $184.32, earning in a Morpho vault.
You: Claim my STAQ
Agent: (your own wallet signs the withdrawal, the reserve pays only its owner, so it can only ever come back to you)

setup: Say: Enable STAQ, 10% of every buy, sell and send
Trade normally, STAQ saves silently into a reserve only you can withdraw from
Ask How much have I STAQ'd? any time, and Claim my STAQ when you want it back
